subject: Estimate received? Quick 15‑minute walkthrough to align next steps

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood estimate and next steps

Hi Julia —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: customer support triage + real-time suggestions (low latency, high throughput).
- Traffic profile: ~350k requests/day with 95th pct TL of 120ms target.
- Data needs: VPC option + audit logs; retention policy will vary by team.

Attached is the estimate + a short deck that maps the proposal to the architecture we discussed (Redwood_Estimate_AcmeTech_20280515.pdf). Key asks: confirm whether your procurement/legal teams need an NDA or a procurement packet up front and whether the retention windows we outlined match your compliance constraints.

If this looks like a fit, I can walk you and any stakeholders through the estimate in a quick 15‑minute call — I can show how batching/quantization tradeoffs affect cost and latency. Would you be available for a brief slot later this week?

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm receipt of the attached estimate.
2) Identify any procurement contacts (I copied Ben to help with contract/terms).
3) If helpful, schedule a 15m walkthrough to go line-by-line.

Thanks — I’ll follow up in a couple days if I don’t hear back.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
